reason: no_reward: PumpBTC on BSC is a stake-only BTCB pool with no function that pays a caller. The five anyone-callable functions (stake, unstakeRequest, claimSlot, claimAll, unstakeInstant) pay only msg.sender's own redemption and all five currently revert 'PumpBTC: only allow stake at first' (onlyAllowStake=true); the fund-moving ops (withdraw, deposit, withdrawAndDeposit) are onlyOperator and pay the caller nothing, and collectFee() is onlyOwner (fees 0.21456 pumpBTC = ~USD 13.8k accrue to the owner). Nothing to keep for the farm: no bounty, no keeper fee, no auction.
